n8fd160707f.headline: India prepared to ‘future-proof’ trade deal as sweetener in US talks, sources say
n8fd160707f.summary: New Delhi is prepared to include a sweetener in trade talks with Washington that would future-proof a trade agreement, sources say. The details of the proposal were not given in the input.
n8fd160707f.why: Trade negotiations between the US and India shape tariffs and market access for a large share of bilateral goods and services trade.

n7eead0b519.headline: Oil prices fall 2% to 2-week low as trade war concerns dampen demand outlook
n7eead0b519.summary: Oil prices fell about 2% to a two-week low on Tuesday. The decline reflected expectations that OPEC+ will boost output and concern that trade war tensions will dampen demand.
n7eead0b519.why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil, and its price moves feed into fuel costs, energy company earnings and inflation expectations.
n7eead0b519.why_moved: Expectations that OPEC+ will raise output and concern that trade war tensions will weaken demand pushed prices lower.

nd78e8af7dc.headline: Gov’t to fund 2025/2026 financial year budget without IMF support
nd78e8af7dc.summary: Kenya's Treasury will have to find alternative sources to fund the Ksh4.2 trillion 2025/26 budget without IMF support, ahead of unveiling the expenditure plan.
nd78e8af7dc.why: IMF programmes signal fiscal discipline to lenders, and their absence changes how governments finance deficits and access external funding.

n6d27d3e295.headline: Power almost restored in Spain, Portugal after blackout
n6d27d3e295.summary: Power has almost entirely been restored to Spain and Portugal following a massive blackout across the Iberian peninsula. The outage disrupted electricity supply across both countries.
n6d27d3e295.why: Electricity supply reliability underpins industrial output and grid operators' costs. Large outages affect utilities, businesses and investor confidence in energy infrastructure.

nd36dbcd01f.headline: Global trade war’s potential blow to Southern African Customs Union revenue
nd36dbcd01f.summary: The trade war is expected to reduce Southern African Customs Union revenue and add strain to regional economies. The decline would weigh on member states' public finances.
nd36dbcd01f.why: SACU is a customs union of Southern African states whose shared revenue pool funds member governments. Tariff-driven trade declines reduce customs income and fiscal space.

na79f660d2c.headline: Namibia's economy expected to grow 3.8 pct in 2025: central bank
na79f660d2c.summary: Namibia's economy is projected to grow 3.8% in 2025 and 4.0% in 2026, according to central bank figures. Growth is driven by crop farming, uranium production and electricity and water.
na79f660d2c.why: Namibia's economy relies on mining, particularly uranium, and central bank growth forecasts inform investor views on the country's fiscal and monetary outlook.

ned348918f9.headline: Ringgit extends gains on positive trade signals, finishing at six-month high
ned348918f9.summary: The ringgit extended gains against the US dollar to close at a six-month high in Kuala Lumpur. An analyst attributed the move to signs of easing global trade tensions.
ned348918f9.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency and is sensitive to regional trade flows and commodity exports. Currency moves affect returns on Malaysian assets for foreign investors.

nb81bd5d564.headline: Baltic electricity prices jump 56 pct last week
nb81bd5d564.summary: Electricity prices in the Baltic bidding areas of the Nord Pool exchange rose an average of 56 percent last week compared with the previous week. Latvenergo was cited by LETA.
nb81bd5d564.why: Nord Pool is the leading Nordic and Baltic power exchange, and its prices reflect supply, demand and generation conditions across the region. Sharp price moves affect power costs for industry and households.

n97cc202787.headline: PSO profit declines 42% to Rs10.67bn in 9 months of FY25
n97cc202787.summary: Pakistan State Oil posted a profit after tax of Rs10.67 billion in the first nine months of FY25, a 42% decline. The fall was reported by Business Recorder.
n97cc202787.why: Pakistan State Oil is the country's largest oil marketing company, and its earnings reflect fuel demand, pricing and margins across Pakistan's energy sector. Its results are closely watched by local and international investors.

nebf5482a2f.headline: ‘Trump is trying to break us’: What to expect from Mark Carney, Canada’s new PM
nebf5482a2f.summary: Mark Carney has become Canada's new prime minister, with coverage focusing on relations with Donald Trump's administration. Reports also cite a historically low Trump approval rating at his 100th day in office.
nebf5482a2f.why: Canada is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so Canadian leadership and trade relations with Washington directly affect trade flows, the Canadian dollar and related markets.

n8cbe14836f.headline: Coca-Cola stock pops on earnings surprise as the company calls Trump tariffs
n8cbe14836f.summary: Coca-Cola beat analyst estimates and did not warn on its annual outlook despite Trump tariffs, sending its stock higher.
n8cbe14836f.why: Coca-Cola is one of the world's largest beverage companies, and its results are read as a gauge of consumer demand and cost pressures.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola
impacts.why: Shares rose after the company beat earnings estimates and did not cut its annual outlook.

na09f42df99.headline: Prosecutors seek 20-year prison term for founder of failed crypto platform Celsius Network
na09f42df99.summary: Prosecutors say the founder and former CEO of failed crypto lender Celsius Network should face 20 years in prison for lying and self-dealing that cost customers billions.
na09f42df99.why: Celsius Network was a crypto lending platform whose collapse in 2022 cost customers heavily and became a reference case for crypto counterparty risk.

ncf177f4fef.headline: Spain's economy grows at slightly slower pace at the start of the year
ncf177f4fef.summary: Spain's economy grew at a slightly slower pace at the start of the year, though it still outperforms many European peers, with consumption expected to stay robust.
ncf177f4fef.why: Spain is the euro area's fourth-largest economy, and its growth trends affect eurozone outlooks and sovereign debt sentiment.

nd9c63303a4.headline: Trump 100 days: Which departments have faced DOGE's cuts so far - complete list
nd9c63303a4.summary: A list of US departments that have faced cuts by the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) in Trump's first 100 days, with supporters citing waste reduction and critics warning of disruption to services.
nd9c63303a4.why: Federal spending cuts affect government contractors, public services and the broader US fiscal outlook.

nab12454db6.headline: Salaries in the public and state sectors higher than in the private sector
nab12454db6.summary: The average net salary in Serbia's public sector was 108,210 dinars in February, higher than pay outside the sector. Entrepreneurs and their employees recorded the lowest average at 53,967 dinars.
nab12454db6.why: Wage levels across public and private sectors shape household spending and labour costs in the Serbian economy.

source.name: Serbian Monitor – Serbia: notizie di economia, politica, cultura e società

sources.name: Serbian Monitor – Serbia: notizie di economia, politica, cultura e società

ne1f67561d9.headline: New UK Government plans to make maximising State Pension payments simpler
ne1f67561d9.summary: The UK government plans to make it simpler to maximise State Pension payments, as the State Pension age is set to rise from 66 to 67 between 2026 and 2028.
ne1f67561d9.why: The State Pension is a major component of UK retirement income, and changes to its age and rules affect pension planning, public spending and labour supply.

ne2a8daf34b.headline: Nigeria’s non-oil exports hit $1.7bn in Q1
ne2a8daf34b.summary: Nigeria's non-oil exports grew 24% to $1.79 billion, or N2.7 trillion, in the first quarter, according to the Nigerian Export Promotion Council. The council made the disclosure on Monday.
ne2a8daf34b.why: Non-oil exports reduce Nigeria's dependence on crude oil revenue and foreign exchange earnings. Growth in these exports matters for the naira and the trade balance.

n32e3ae1174.headline: NIGERIA DAILY: Why The Price Of Rice Is Falling In Parts Of...
n32e3ae1174.summary: Rice prices are falling in parts of Nigeria, with a 50kg bag now selling between ₦60,000 and ₦63,000 in places like Lagos, Ogun and Niger. The report covers local market prices.
n32e3ae1174.why: Food prices are a key driver of inflation in Nigeria, which influences interest rates and consumer spending in the economy.

n2ced01769f.headline: Economists weigh in as CBN’s Cardoso vows to curb inflation
n2ced01769f.summary: Economists have weighed in on a speech by Central Bank of Nigeria Governor Olayemi Cardoso, who vowed to curb inflation at the 2025 Spring Meetings.
n2ced01769f.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria sets monetary policy for Africa's largest economy, and its inflation strategy affects interest rates, the naira and investment returns.

n338688df61.headline: TI Nigeria backs NNPCL probe, seeks comprehensive oil...
n338688df61.summary: Transparency International Nigeria backed a probe into NNPC Limited and called for comprehensive oil sector reviews. The group is a civil society organisation focused on anti-corruption.
n338688df61.why: NNPC Limited is Nigeria's state oil company, and governance of the oil sector affects government revenue and investor confidence in Nigerian energy.

n22ae5f9b58.headline: Manufacturers' monstrous unplanned inventory
n22ae5f9b58.summary: Nigeria's manufacturing sector is burdened by large unplanned inventory, according to the report. Unplanned inventory is the stock of goods that accumulates when sales fall short of production.
n22ae5f9b58.why: Manufacturers' inventory levels are a signal of demand and production health, which affects output, employment and industrial investment.

n643f0d6dfd.headline: 50.1% of Nigerians’ monthly income spent on food – Report
n643f0d6dfd.summary: A report by Lagos-based marketing firm SEID found that 50.1 per cent of Nigerians' monthly income is spent on food, as prices rise.
n643f0d6dfd.why: A high share of household income spent on food signals weak consumer purchasing power, which matters for consumer-goods and retail demand in Nigeria.

n2deacf2e09.headline: CBN announces revised requirements for PAPSS transactions
n2deacf2e09.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has announced a review of documentation requirements for transactions made through the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System.
n2deacf2e09.why: PAPSS is a pan-African platform for cross-border payments in local currencies, and changes to its rules affect trade settlement for Nigerian banks and firms.

n4a15862d46.headline: You risk being jailed, CAC warns owners of unregistered...
n4a15862d46.summary: Nigeria's Corporate Affairs Commission has issued a six-week notice to unregistered businesses to register with the Commission. It warned that owners risk being jailed.
n4a15862d46.why: The Corporate Affairs Commission is Nigeria's company registrar, and its rules determine which businesses are formally recognised for lending, contracts and tax.

n3418d38633.headline: General Motors posts strong results but will reassess projections due to tariffs
n3418d38633.summary: General Motors posted strong results but said it will reassess its projections because of tariffs. Its stock fell more than 2% before the market opened.
n3418d38633.why: General Motors is a major US automaker, so its margins and forecasts are sensitive to tariffs on imported parts and vehicles.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: The company said it will reassess its projections due to tariffs, and its shares fell before the open.

n47cd43e8e2.headline: Election pledges putting Australia's AAA credit rating at risk: S&P
n47cd43e8e2.summary: S&P has warned that Australia's top AAA rating is under threat from billions of dollars in election commitments from both major parties.
n47cd43e8e2.why: A sovereign credit rating reflects a government's ability to repay debt and sets the borrowing cost benchmark for its bonds. A downgrade can raise government borrowing costs.

n5e50944b09.headline: China’s Xi pushes AI and ‘Global South’ opportunity amid US trade war
n5e50944b09.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping visited the New Development Bank and promoted AI and Global South opportunities as the US trade war continues.
n5e50944b09.why: The New Development Bank is the BRICS-backed multilateral lender. China's positioning among developing economies shapes trade and investment flows.

n497e0ff1ea.headline: At BRICS meeting, China vows to stand firm against ‘bully’ Trump
n497e0ff1ea.summary: China's Foreign Minister warned BRICS nations on Tuesday not to cave to U.S. tariffs and urged resistance to pressure amid growing trade tensions.
n497e0ff1ea.why: BRICS is a bloc of major emerging economies that coordinates on trade and finance. Its positions on U.S. tariffs can shape trade relations and emerging-market sentiment.

n669e0b2da6.headline: AstraZeneca says potential US tariffs manageable, faces another China fine
n669e0b2da6.summary: AstraZeneca said potential US tariffs on pharmaceutical imports would have only a limited impact and it would keep its 2025 forecasts. The drugmaker also faces another fine in China.
n669e0b2da6.why: AstraZeneca is a large British-headquartered drugmaker with major US and Chinese sales. Tariffs and regulatory fines both affect its revenue and earnings outlook.

nd4a6b648cd.headline: Elections in Canada, Mark Carney wins: who is the liberal who promises "war" to Trump
nd4a6b648cd.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney's Liberals won the Canadian election, according to projections by various media outlets. The result gives the party another mandate.
nd4a6b648cd.why: Canada's government sets trade, fiscal and energy policy for one of the G7 economies and a major exporter to the United States.

n677e7a5a78.headline: GM pulls forecast due to tariffs as nervous consumers rush to buy
n677e7a5a78.summary: General Motors has pulled its forecast due to tariffs, while nervous consumers rush to buy. CFO Paul Jacobson said the future impact of tariffs could be significant.
n677e7a5a78.why: General Motors is a major US automaker, and its guidance is watched as a read on auto demand and trade costs.

impacts.name: General Motors
impacts.why: Withdrawing its forecast removes investors' guidance on earnings, and the company cites tariff risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n677e7a5a78.why_moved: GM pulled its forecast and its CFO said the future impact of tariffs could be significant. Withdrawn guidance leaves investors with less visibility on earnings.

nfd28a51c72.headline: India prepared to
nfd28a51c72.summary: India is reportedly considering a "forward most-favoured-nation" clause in trade talks with the US, which would give Washington the best tariff terms India offers any nation. India has made preemptive concessions.
nfd28a51c72.why: Trade agreements between the US and India shape tariffs, market access and supply chains for exporters in both countries.

n245bcd1bfa.headline: German consumer sentiment rises again but remains fragile
n245bcd1bfa.summary: German consumer sentiment improved for a second month in April, driven by higher income expectations and lower savings. It remains weak amid ongoing recession fears, GfK and NIM report.
n245bcd1bfa.why: Consumer sentiment surveys such as the GfK index indicate household spending appetite, which matters for Germany's largest economy.

n47377735e0.headline: IReit Global reports higher committed occupancy and stable leverage for Q1 2025
n47377735e0.summary: IReit Global said committed occupancy was marginally higher, driven by new leases in its Spanish portfolio. The Singapore-listed REIT also reported stable leverage for the first quarter of 2025.
n47377735e0.why: IReit Global is a real estate investment trust, and occupancy and leverage levels are key measures of its rental income and financial risk.

n265e7c8a15.headline: Gold prices: Pinetree
n265e7c8a15.summary: Gold prices have surged amid geopolitical tensions. Pinetree's Ritesh Jain expects the bull run to continue and projects prices of $7,000 to $8,000, citing Indian household demand.
n265e7c8a15.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that tends to attract buying during geopolitical stress. Indian households are among the largest sources of physical gold demand.

nc68d1390a6.headline: Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre loses his own seat in Canadian Parliament
nc68d1390a6.summary: Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre lost his own seat in Canada's Parliament, according to the report, which describes him as a career politician who campaigned with Trump-like bravado.
nc68d1390a6.why: The Conservative Party is Canada's main opposition, and leadership changes affect the direction of Canadian fiscal, trade and economic policy.

n599cb820aa.headline: Money News with Deb Knight - 29th April
n599cb820aa.summary: Economist and former central banker Mark Carney won the Canadian election, according to the Money News segment, which also previewed the Coalition's economic plans.
n599cb820aa.why: Carney, a former Bank of Canada and Bank of England governor, will shape Canada's fiscal and monetary direction, which affects the Canadian dollar, bonds and sector policy.

nd471e0cf22.headline: Swiss Nylon maker EMS Chemie's sales dip, 2025 looks 'challenging'
nd471e0cf22.summary: Swiss nylon maker EMS Chemie reported a 4% decline in first-quarter net sales, citing market-driven lower prices and cost levels. It warned that 2025 looks particularly challenging.
nd471e0cf22.why: EMS Chemie is a Swiss specialty chemicals company making high-performance polyamides used in automotive and industrial applications. Its results signal conditions in those end markets.

ndb1c4233cf.headline: First Reit Q1 DPU dips 3.3% to S$0.0058 amid forex headwinds
ndb1c4233cf.summary: First REIT's distribution per unit dipped 3.3% to S$0.0058 amid forex headwinds. Distributable income slipped 2.2% to S$12.2 million.
ndb1c4233cf.why: First REIT is a Singapore-listed real estate investment trust owning healthcare-related properties. Distribution per unit is the key payout measure for its unitholders.

nac741d029f.headline: Thailand looks to South Korea to shape future economy
nac741d029f.summary: Thailand is pushing for South Korean investment as it aims to build a green and digital future for its economy. No specific deal amounts are given in the report.
nac741d029f.why: Foreign direct investment shapes Thailand's industrial growth and its position in regional supply chains.

n605314a20d.headline: France targets cheap Chinese goods with fee on packages
n605314a20d.summary: French ministers said France wants to charge non-EU online sellers a handling fee on each low-value package shipped to domestic customers. The measure targets cheap Chinese goods.
n605314a20d.why: Low-value e-commerce imports from Asia have grown quickly, and fees on them affect online retailers and cross-border trade flows.

nff1b966b7a.headline: Netherlands sees drop in strikes, rise in worker participation
nff1b966b7a.summary: Strikes in the Netherlands fell to 36 in 2024 from 52 in 2023, the first decline since the COVID-19 pandemic. More workers took part in strikes than the year before, per CBS.
nff1b966b7a.why: Labour disputes affect productivity and wage negotiations, which matter for corporate costs and the wider economy.

n6324c52a3c.headline: Independent review clears Adani Green of US indictment over irregularities
n6324c52a3c.summary: An independent review by law firms appointed in January 2025 has cleared Adani Green Energy of irregularities tied to a US indictment. The review was commissioned by the company.
n6324c52a3c.why: Adani Green is a major Indian renewable energy developer, and legal issues with US authorities can affect its financing and investor confidence.

n03dd55f7e0.headline: Lower rates cause savings withdrawals in Vietnam
n03dd55f7e0.summary: Vietnamese customers are gradually withdrawing money from banks to seek other investment channels. Lower bank deposit rates have made savings less attractive.
n03dd55f7e0.why: Bank deposits are a core funding source for lenders, so withdrawals can tighten liquidity. Deposit rates are set by commercial banks in response to the central bank's policy stance.

n99c2dad50a.headline: Canada's Liberals secure comeback victory made possible by Trump
n99c2dad50a.summary: Mark Carney's Liberal Party pulled off an election win that once looked near-impossible. The result followed US President Donald Trump targeting Canada.
n99c2dad50a.why: Canada's federal government sets trade, fiscal and regulatory policy, and changes in leadership affect investor expectations for the Canadian economy.

n7d961a9bcf.headline: Reserve Bank may need to make deeper OCR cuts - ASB
n7d961a9bcf.summary: An ASB economist said the Reserve Bank of New Zealand may have to cut its benchmark cash rate even further. The comment points to a possible easing path.
n7d961a9bcf.why: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand sets the official cash rate, which drives borrowing costs across the economy and influences the New Zealand dollar.

n0619115fdd.headline: ‘A year of unknowns’ for Montana tourism
n0619115fdd.summary: A trade war and strained foreign relations, particularly with Canada, bring uncertainty to western Montana's tourism industry. The article describes the outlook as unclear.
n0619115fdd.why: Tourism is an important revenue source for Montana, and cross-border travel from Canada is a meaningful part of visitor demand in the region.

n22c47c1dc5.headline: Smith says many Albertans frustrated by federal election, wants to ‘reset’ relationship with Ottawa  | Globalnews.ca
n22c47c1dc5.summary: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith said many Albertans are frustrated by the federal election. She accused the federal Liberal government of having overtly attacked Alberta's economy over the past decade.
n22c47c1dc5.why: Alberta is a major energy-producing province, and its relationship with the federal government shapes policy on oil, gas and resource development.

nac192d280e.headline: Indonesian bonds set for first foreign outflows in five months
nac192d280e.summary: Foreign investors withdrew funds from Indonesian bonds, marking the first outflow in five months amid changing global and local market conditions.
nac192d280e.why: Bond flows influence Indonesia's borrowing costs and currency stability, affecting economic growth prospects.

n82212f5c03.headline: Up 40% in 2025: Is It Too Late to Buy Palantir Stock?
n82212f5c03.summary: Palantir, a data analytics firm, has gained 40% in 2025 as investor interest in its growth prospects persists.
n82212f5c03.why: Palantir provides data mining and analytics services, with its stock performance reflecting investor confidence in its technology and growth potential.

n829fe8f144.headline: Hanwha in advanced talks over arms production for Saudi Arabia
n829fe8f144.why: Defense contracts with Middle Eastern countries can significantly impact Hanwha's revenue and regional geopolitical influence.

n97b783794b.headline: MF Central by CAMS and KFintech: Consolidate, update and transfer mutual funds easily | Mint
n97b783794b.summary: MF Central, backed by CAMS and KFintech, enables folio consolidation, updates, and transmission of mutual fund units, enhancing investor convenience and compliance.
n97b783794b.why: Improved mutual fund management platforms support financial inclusion and operational efficiency in India’s growing asset management industry.

n138a0c507f.headline: Maharashtra top performing state, southern states dominate in environment and governance areas: CareEdge ratings
n138a0c507f.summary: CareEdge ratings rank Maharashtra as the top performing Indian state in financial development, with southern states dominating in environment and governance metrics.
n138a0c507f.why: State-level economic and governance performance influences investment attractiveness and regional economic growth in India.

n4d2890ec67.headline: Indonesia pushes for transformation of IMF-World Bank for global stability
n4d2890ec67.summary: Indonesia is pushing for the transformation of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank to maintain global stability and sustainable development.
n4d2890ec67.why: The IMF and World Bank provide financing and policy advice to developing economies, and changes to their governance affect global lending and capital flows.

n27aa73f01f.headline: "QS Lasers" to lay off 12 employees
n27aa73f01f.summary: Vilnius-based laser manufacturer QS Lasers will lay off 12 employees, according to the Employment Service. The report was published by LRT.
n27aa73f01f.why: Layoffs at manufacturing firms can signal demand or cost pressures in the sector. QS Lasers is a small Lithuanian laser manufacturer.
